known_issues: Skill rolls are forced by answering math.random with its lower bound (0 for a bare call) while one event is dispatched; an implementation that draws randomness another way (for example from a private generator) would not see the forced roll and the preserved skill cases could fail. The mod itself only uses math.random.

The events are pushed directly with the same payloads the game uses (EntityScript:PushBufferedAction/PerformBufferedAction for performaction, Combat:GetAttacked for attacked); the base-game action itself is not executed.

The save from another Exp-gain setting is a real save record whose dsmmo_level_up_rate is changed and whose DIG level and next-level experience are made stale; a save written by an actual earlier server run is not used.
